name: Velha da Égua Branca
body:
Velha da Égua Branca
CR 21

This wrinkled, aged woman wears a white headdress adorned with red ribbons and clutches a dagger. Her clothing and leather shoes are otherwise ragged. She sits astride a blazing white stallion bedecked with tack and harness covered in bells, jugs, and clay pots.

XP 409,600
N Medium fey (unique)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +29

DEFENSE

AC 39, touch 19, flat-footed 30 (+8 Dex, +1 dodge, +20 natural)
hp 380 (40d6+200)
Fort +20, Ref +30, Will +30
DR 5/cold iron; SR 32

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover)
Melee dagger +33/+28/+23/+18 (1d4+11/17-20)
Ranged moonlight lance +28 (20d10)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks fear (60-ft. cone, DC 36), moonlight lance, cacophonous shout (DC 36)

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 26, Con 20, Int 12, Wis 23, Cha 22
Base Atk +20; CMB +26; CMD 44
Feats Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (dagger), Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Mounted Combat, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Toughness, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +26, Climb +27, Escape Artist +26, Fly +20, Intimidate +26, Knowledge (geography) +19, Knowledge (nature) +19, Perception +29, Ride +20, Sense Motive +16, Stealth +19
Languages Common, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cacophonous Shout (Su)

Once per day, the Velha de égua Branca can emit a devastating wailing as per the spell shout, but it deals 20d6 sonic damage (20d8 against crystalline or brittle creatures or objects) and affects a 60-ft. cone.

Fear (Su)

Once per day, the Velha de égua branca can use fear, as the spell, affecting a 60-foot cone-shaped spread.

Moonlight Lance (Su)

Three times per day, the Velha de égua branca can cast a beam of silvery light from her hand. This is a ray with a range of 60 feet that deals 20d10 damage. This damage is pure magical energy and not of a particular energy type. A target that is a shapechanger with a weakness to silvered weapons (such as a lycanthrope‘s DR/silver) who is struck must succeed on a DC 36 Fortitude save or instantly revert to its true form and be unable to use its shapechange ability for 1 minute.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization pair (with the égua branca)
Treasure standard (+5 dagger and other treasure)
